smallest_supported_claim: This segment establishes a current source-bound native package interaction and a successful native quicksave followed by confirmed save-and-quit, main-menu quit, and process exit. It does not by itself establish restored state or continued behavior.
causal_account: Native semantic receipts identify the selected actions and exact run/frame identities. The world pause produced a native reply from Katharina after the submitted sentence, and quicksave reported saved before native save-and-quit and process exit. Reload and post-reload state remain unobserved until the declared continuation.

citations.meaning: Current source/executable/run/binding identity for the segment.
Native free-text prompt submission was accepted on the bound frame.
A later ordinary native pause was accepted, producing the next bound frame and allowing the native response to be observed.
Native quicksave receipt was accepted; its resulting observation reported last_save_result saved.
Native save-and-quit action was accepted and opened the native confirmation owner.
Native main-menu quit action was accepted before process exit.
The original bound process exited with code 0; the native observation explicitly says exit alone does not establish save durability.

remaining_unknowns: New-process relaunch, durable identity/value comparison, stale-grant rejection, and later ordinary behavior are pending the declared continuation.
